text:
White woman, pink woman.


She comes near me or goes far away.
By marvelous virtue,
she turns into a butterfly for me
in a world of reflections.


White woman, pink woman.


She comes near me or goes far away.
Catching fire, she becomes divine
in the mysterious moon
of the country of mirrors.

translation.title: Song in White and Pink
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated white/pink apparition and the mirror-world transformation.
